title: How ERC-8004 composes with the other seven
caption: ERC-8004 is an identity and reputation layer with one strong documented link (x402), an MPP link in two parts (the discovery draft cites it, and since 2026-11-16 the mppx SDK can authenticate an ERC-8004 agent by its registered wallet), one indirect path (A2A to AP2) and no documented link to TAP, ACP, UCP or Agent Pay (searched 2026-10-18). Companion ERCs build around it.
alt: Flowchart. ERC-8004 in the center. x402 is linked by x402Support, agentWallet as payee and proofOfPayment in feedback files. The MPP discovery draft (Tempo Labs, Merit Systems) cites ERC-8004 for possible future on-chain anchoring, and the mppx SDK, MPP's reference SDK from version 0.20.0, sends Agent-Id and Agent-Signature headers and reads getAgentWallet from the Identity Registry. AP2 connects indirectly through A2A agent cards listed as services. Visa TAP, OpenAI ACP, Google UCP and Mastercard Agent Pay have no documented relation. Companion standards ERC-8122, ERC-8217, ERC-8126, ERC-8183 and ERC-8226 build on or around ERC-8004; ERC-8226 bridges to ERC-3643 regulated tokens.
